features: 【Paper-Like Ink Reading Experience 】Enjoy a natural, paper-like reading experience with the M3 e-reader’s Ink display, which offers crisp text, reduced glare, and soft illumination. A 10-level adjustable front light lets you fine-tune brightness for any environment, making reading comfortable in bright daylight or low light.

【Ultra-Portable & Long-Lasting Battery】Compact and lightweight, this e-reader easily fits in a pocket or bag. The energy-efficient display extends battery life for uninterrupted reading at home, commuting, or travel.

【Multi-Format Support for Flexible Reading】Supports TXT and EPUB e-book formats, plus audio formats like MP3, WAV, AAC, and FLAC with wired headphone compatibility. Enjoy reading and listening simultaneously for a versatile media experience.

【Offline Operation with Clock & Weather Features】Equipped with an independent clock chip, the M3 e-reader displays time and calendar offline. The built-in weather function lets you check basic conditions for selected cities, all within a simple, ad-free interface.

【Highly Customizable Settings】Adjust alarms, language, lock screen, and SD card settings to match personal reading habits. Simple navigation and personalization options make the device intuitive for both new and experienced readers.
description: The HamGeek M3 Portable E-Book Reader is a compact and lightweight digital reading device designed for users who want a comfortable paper-like reading experience anytime, anywhere. The 3.7′′ electronic ink display reduces eye strain and delivers crisp, easy-to-read text in a variety of lighting conditions. With its long battery life and intuitive control layout, this reader allows you to enjoy your favorite stories and digital books on the go. This reader supports common digital text formats and is ideal for commuters, students, and leisure readers alike. Its simple interface and portable design make it a convenient choice for building and accessing your digital library whether at home, on the road, or outdoors.
